record.one_liner: Asana is a work management platform for organizing tasks, projects, and goals across teams.
record.auth_notes: Personal access token (long-lived, sent as a Bearer token, acts as the generating user). OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE and refresh tokens (access token valid 1 hour), with resource:action scopes. Service accounts (Enterprise tier only, created by super admins) are listed under Other. OIDC is for sign-in only.
record.access_notes: PATs and OAuth apps are created in the developer console. The overview page says you can test with a free account and offers a developer sandbox for premium features. No page I fetched states outright that free accounts get full API access. The rate-limits page does list a free-domain tier (150 req/min), which implies free-tier API use. Service accounts need Enterprise. I did not read the "manage distribution" page, so I can't say whether OAuth apps need approval to be used in other workspaces.
record.blocker: Rate limits: 150 req/min on free domains, 1,500 on paid, and 60 req/min for search. Admins can block MCP clients. The OAuth app distribution/approval rules for other workspaces weren't verified. Premium-only endpoints may need a paid plan. The deprecated v1 MCP SSE endpoint shuts down 05/11/2026.
